title: Law to require timely CityFHEPS rent payments to landlords
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services to make CityFHEPS rental assistance payments no later than 7 days before the first day of the month they cover. The change affects landlords who receive these payments on behalf of low-income tenants under the CityFHEPS voucher program. The law would take effect 120 days after becoming law.
